text:
forget the wallet deposits and withdrawals completely. the profit can be tracked like this: 

total winnings paid from all bets and bids - total cost of all bets and bids. 

for the total, this will go the math for all bets and bids ever made from the wallet. for daily stats, it will calculate total winnings from bets and bids for that particular sports day (which begins and ends with the first and last game for that day's slate) - total amount of money spent on all bets and bids for that day. if I'm looking at the current day, it should only show the current winnings from that day's game slate (final results only) - the cost of all of those same bets and bids and ignoring any bets and bids without final results. this will give me an accurate reading of how my betting is going throughout the day, which means it should refresh when new results come in. 

for all stats and graphs, omit the cost of all bets and bids for games that are not final (such as bets and bids for days ahead or games scheduled the same day but not final). the reason for this is to not count bets and bids with no result as a loss.
